Class ChestOverlayHelpers

java.lang.Object
org.cyclops.colossalchests2.api.client.ChestOverlayHelpers
public final class ChestOverlayHelpers extends Object
Drawing helpers for IChestOverlays, in the face's unit square.

      poseStack - The pose stack.
      collector - Collects what to draw.
      sprite - A sprite, whose outer rows texture the sides.
      depth - How far the face lies in front of the chest surface.
      light - The packed light.
      overlay - The packed overlay.
